notes.TWN: 世界銀行（ICAO）沒有台灣。民航局統計的台灣各機場旅客（入境、出境與過境，國內線在起降兩端各算一次）2025 年 6,889 萬人次（國際 5,231 萬、兩岸 580 萬、國內 1,056 萬），2019 年 7,216 萬人次；算的是機場的旅客，不是國籍航空公司的載客，跟地圖上的數字不能直接比。

notesEn.TWN: The World Bank (ICAO) has no data for Taiwan. Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration counted 68.9 million passengers at Taiwan’s airports in 2025 (arrivals, departures and transit; domestic passengers are counted at both ends): 52.3 million international, 5.8 million cross-strait and 10.6 million domestic, against 72.2 million in 2019. These are airport passengers, not passengers carried by Taiwanese airlines, so they cannot be compared directly with the figures on the map.
